ImageDescription.value: Crowd at the Court house square in Benghazi, April 2011. The square was a place for gathering, demonstrations and organisation of the uprise movement. The walls of the court house are draped with pictures of casualties of the fighting, as well as former executions by Gaddafi, mourners passing by. Flags and souvenirs are sold at a table in the center. The red-white flag on the left marks the al-Ahly soccer club that was destroyed by Gaddafi's order in 2000, and three leaders executed, after insubordination.
